brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the town of Tuqu southeast of Bethlehem, the Ma'an news agency reported. Details of the incursion, including its duration and stated purpose, were not immediately clear.

Tuqu lies in the southern West Bank, in an area that has experienced periodic Israeli military operations. The raid adds to a pattern of frequent incursions into Palestinian towns and villages across the occupied territory.
title: Israeli forces raid Tuqu town southeast of Bethlehem
